title: Enrollment (Vault-coupled) extraction and legacy route retirement
statusScope: PRJ-05 as scoped: everything that lived in routes/projects.ts is extracted; the three legacy route files are thin adapters with no DB access and no outside importers. NOT unified: the enrollment write paths in routes/teams.ts and routes/bulk.ts and the delete cascade in services/sync.ts (different semantics; unifying would change behavior), so the roadmap gate 'no duplicate enrollment logic' is met for logic inside routes/projects.ts only. Typecheck, build and tests ran in a scratch copy installed with --no-frozen-lockfile; the repo's frozen install still fails. Parity was shown against fake databases and stubbed PEP/credits/activity-log, not real Postgres or the real policy engine.
